title: Nrịgo nke Onye Nrọ
intro: Mkpụrụ obi a kara aka maka ịdị ukwuu, mana ọnwụnwa siri ike nwalere, malitere njem pụrụ iche. Ụzọ onye a jupụtara n'ekworo, nkewa, na nhụjuanya na-ezighị ezi, naanị ruo n'ọnọdụ ibu ọrụ dị ukwuu na nzụkọ miri emi. Ị nwere ike ịchọpụta onye a dị ịrịba ama site na Quran?
clues: Ndị kacha m nso na-enwere m anyaụfụ, nke mere ka m kewapụ onwe m n'ebe nne na nna m na ụlọ m nọ.
Enwere m oge ihe isi ike dị ukwuu, gụnyere ire m n'ọnụ ego dị nta site n'aka ndị njem.
E boro m ebubo na m mere ihe ọjọọ n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi, m nọkwara ọtụtụ afọ n'ụlọ mkpọrọ, ma okwukwe m nọgidere na-agbanwe agbanwe.
E nyere m ikike pụrụ iche ịkọwa ọhụụ dị mgbagwoju anya, nke nyeere m aka n'ụzọ m si enweta nnwere onwe.
Amamihe na iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe m mechara mee ka m nweta ọkwa dị elu nke ọchịchị na ntụkwasị obi n'ala ọzọ.
Site n'ọtụtụ ihe omume, ejikọtaghachiri m na nne na nna m meworo agadi na ụmụnne m mgbe m nọsịrị ogologo oge ma na-enwe mwute.

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: Ịrụ Ụgbọ iji zọpụta ihe e kere eke
Ịhụ onye ọchịchị aka ike n'anya site n'ọrụ ebube
A na-anwale ya na ọrịa siri ike na mfu

location.label: Isi Ihe
options: Nne kamel dị ka ihe ịrịba ama

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: Iduzi njem gaa ala e kwere ná nkwa
Ịghọ onye minista dị ike na Ijipt
Ịnata ikpe Chineke n'isi ndị mpako
Ịchị alaeze ukwu n'amamihe na ikpe ziri ezi
outcome.answer: Ịghọ onye minista dị ike na Ijipt

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِأَبِيهِ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى رَأَيْتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَبًۭا وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ رَأَيْتُهُمْ لِى سَـٰجِدِينَ
verse: [Of these stories mention] when Joseph said to his father, "O my father, indeed I have seen [in a dream] eleven stars and the sun and the moon; I saw them prostrating to me." (12:4)
